binding_status.description: Whether the operator has confirmed the binding or it is still a candidate

coordinate.description: A per-entity override selector; null for the default binding

doc_type.description: The specific document type this binding locates, or null for the project's general home; part of the supersede key

entity_type.description: The entity kind whose documents this binding locates; fixed by the shelf key for this member, and part of the supersede key

source_system.description: The producing system of the fact; no harvested origin exists

sources.description: The ordered list of places to look; each element is one complete declarative locator

sources[].connector_ref.description: The logical alias of the connector that reaches this source; also the field the operator export filter compares

sources[].doc_subpath.description: An optional fixed sub-path inside the entity folder where this doc type's files sit

sources[].entity_folder_pattern.description: How each project's own folder is named, binding a folder to the entity by its number token

sources[].file_glob.description: The file match for this doc type: `*` (no filter) or a single `*.ext` glob

sources[].folder_pattern.description: A case-insensitive regex matched against folder names at any depth, used where no single sub-path name holds

sources[].lifecycle_folders.description: The status-tagged folders to traverse, each with a folder name and the entity status it holds

sources[].root_folder.description: The path under the store root to start from (null/empty for systems addressed by site+drive); required in practice when `system = DROPBOX`

sources[].store_drive_id.description: The store's drive identifier; required in practice when `system = SHAREPOINT`

sources[].store_drive_name.description: The drive's display name, used to translate between the store root and display paths

sources[].store_site_id.description: The store's site identifier; required in practice when `system = SHAREPOINT`

sources[].store_site_name.description: The operator-facing site label; **no reader touches it**

sources[].system.description: The storage system of one source; only SharePoint and Dropbox are crawlable
